text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - The Canadian Wheat Board reportedly sold 600,000 tonnes of wheat to Brazil overnight, FOB St. Lawrence, for May-July shipment. A CWB official declined to comment but said a rumored price of US$150 per tonne, FOB, was too low.
WHEAT SALE - Syria sold 15,000 tonnes of durum wheat to Turkey for $191.10 per tonne for April 15/May 15 shipment.
CORN SALE - South Korea bought 126,500 tonnes of Chinese corn from Toepfer for $140.95 to $142.90 per tonne, C & F, for July-September shipment.

SOYBEAN SALE - Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans from Continental for 97.86 cents over CBOT May, C&F. Shipment was slated for April 11-25 if U.S. Gulf or April 26-May 10 if Pacific Northwest.
SOYBEAN SALE - South Korea bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans for March 25-April 10 shipment from the U.S. Gulf.
SOYBEAN SALE - A Thai crusher bought 50,000 tonnes of optional origin soybeans for March-April shipment.
BARLEY SALE - Syria sold Jordan 100,000 tonnes of black barley for $138 per tonne for April/May shipment.
CORN TENDER - South Korea is seeking 190,000 tonnes of Chinese corn for July/August shipment.

CORN TENDER - Taiwan will tender Tuesday for 108,000 tonnes of No. 2 U.S. corn. It seeks two 54,000-tonne cargoes. The first is for May 11-25 from the U.S. Gulf or May 26 to June 9 if from West Coast ports. The second cargo is for May 25 to June 8 from the U.S. Gulf or June 9-23 from the West Coast.
WHEAT TENDERS - News was awaited on Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat slated for May delivery, several U.S. exporters said.

- Lebanon will tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat next week. Bids would be for two shipments CIF to Beirut port silos of 25,000 tonnes each, the first between April 15 and May 10 and the second between June 20 and July 15.
- Sri Lanka said it would tender for 50,000 tonnes each of hard and soft wheat. The tender will close on March 13.
- The CCC is seeking up to 25,550 tonnes of wheat for donation to Jordan and Yemen for April 1-25 shipment.

WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - The CCC said it was tendering on March 12 to buy up to 15,180 tonnes of U.S. hard red wheat for export to Angola, April 1-25 shipment. CCC said it was seeking no. 2 or better hard red spring or hard red winter wheat.

CORN TENDER - The CCC said it was tendering on March 12 to buy up to 16,080 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn, for export to Angola. CCC said it was seeking No. 2 or better U.S. yellow corn, maximum moisture 14.5 percent, for April 1-25 shipment.

MARKET TALK - Argentine exporters had sold between 8,027,000 and 8,327,000 tonnes of 1996/97 wheat by February 20 and 4.39 million tonnes of corn, a market source said... Brazilian soybean exports should grow 74 percent to 6.3 million tonnes in the 1997/98 marketing year (Feb/Jan) from last year's 3.62 million tonnes, said independent consultants Safras e Mercado...The European Commission has re-submitted a proposal to open a 30,000-tonne reduced tariff quota for imports of U.S. malting barley, a European Commission official said Tuesday...Slovakia is importing 400,000 tonnes of grain to cover a shortfall until the 1997 crop is harvested... Poland will import 200,000 tonnes of grain in the first quarter of this year...China's corn exports could double to more than two million tonnes this year.
